done_rule: SV is recognized fully_certified when the multi-config certificate-coverage union UNKNOWN reaches 0. Until then the recognized fully_certified-accounting basis is the sound multi-config union (expected_union_unknown), whose residual rule set must equal expected_union_residual_rules exactly (order-insensitive) and be deterministic (byte-identical) across all declared seeds, with sample_parse_failures=0; the canonical single-config accounting (expected_canonical_unknown) is recorded alongside. The union is sound by construction: a rule is credited only when some config POSITIVELY covers it (a proof or a witness), never merely because a profile leaves the rule out of its universe.
